claim_summary: Quant-Arena contributes a benchmark for LLMs to construct and revise stock-scoring strategies from A-share data and assess frozen strategies on a sealed period under shared trading rules.

claim_evidence.quote: We introduce Quant-Arena, a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research
on real A-share market data. A model constructs features and stock-scoring code, receives feedback

modules.name: Date-scoped market data interface
modules.scope_reason: The interface gates temporal observations by decision date, so its assumptions concern data availability over time and apply beyond trading; if the task changed, the date-scoped data access could remain, while trading portfolio rules and objectives would need redesign.
rubric_path: R1:contributed - the work introduces a controlled data interface
R2:Harness - the interface executes around the model
R3_1_TSK:no - the date/instrument/field access is not bound to a task objective
R3_2_GTS:yes - access is date-scoped and tied to temporal availability

evidence.quote: The data interface restricts access by date, instrument, and field.
At each decision date, the strategy can access authorized historical observations, including permitted warmup history.

modules.name: Bounded research and sealed strategy assessment
modules.scope_reason: The procedure binds candidate feedback, the frozen stock-scoring program, portfolio construction, and cash-account evaluation to a trading-strategy output contract; if the task changed, the temporal state and evaluator's portfolio rules/objective would need redesign, so it is TSK rather than a general temporal harness.
rubric_path: R1:contributed - the work defines the research and assessment procedure
R2:Harness - the evaluation workflow surrounds model calls
R3_1_TSK:yes - the objective and validation criteria are quantitative trading strategy outcomes

evidence.quote: Models may evaluate candidate strategies on the research period and revise their code using aggregate return, signal-quality and coverage statistics, and execution errors.
At the end of research, one strategy’s source code, execution environment, and declared features are frozen.
The evaluator applies this strategy once to the sealed out-of-sample period.

process_validity.quote: Each run may evaluate at most five candidates on the research period.

temporal_validity.quote: At the end of research, one strategy’s source code, execution environment, and declared features are frozen.

task_performance.quote: Signal metrics include mean daily RankIC, its annualized information ratio (A), long–short Sharpe (SRLS ) between the highest- and lowest-scored deciles, and turnover, the average daily replacement fraction of the portfolio.

decision_utility.quote: We report out-of-sample annualized return and excess return over a full-market equal-weight reference aligned to the same trading days.

changes: dimensions: remove Memory and Context; retain Tools and Execution
functions: add validation for date-scoped information availability
reconciliation.reason: The packet supports a date-gated temporal data interface (L92-L94), but does not describe persistent or organized memory across steps.

changes: dimensions: replace retired Control, Verification, and Feedback and Planning and Workflow with Planning and Orchestration
retain TSK and assign validation function
reconciliation.reason: The protocol embeds the trading-strategy objective and evaluator criteria (L109-L116); the sealed frozen assessment implements temporal validation as part of this task procedure.

notes: The work evaluates participant models and agent harnesses but does not contribute a general-purpose agent runtime; the task-specific protocol is counted as a benchmark procedure.
